run_form_composer_dynamic_task: run the mephisto form composer dynamic task on EC2 with Prolific workers using the task_script CLI decorator
generate_task_data_config: generate an extrapolated task_data.json config file from existing form unit and token sets values config files
build_form_composer_dynamic_ec2_prolific: build and deploy the form composer dynamic React app on EC2 for Prolific worker platform
configure_prolific_qualifications: configure Prolific-specific qualifications like AgeRangeEligibilityRequirement with min and max age bounds on shared state
launch_and_wait_for_task: launch a mephisto task run with shared static task state then wait for completion before shutting down
